title: CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers
chineseTitle: 第 7 章：安妮的第一次祈祷

paragraphs.en: Anne's evening with Marilla began with a stern discussion about tidiness. "Now, Anne," Marilla said stiffly, "I noticed last night that you threw your clothes all over the floor when you took them off. That is very untidy and unacceptable here."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮与玛丽拉的傍晚对话一开始便严肃地讨论起整洁问题。“现在，安妮，”玛丽拉板着脸说道，“我注意到你昨晚脱衣服时把衣物扔得满地都是。这里不允许这么乱糟糟的。”

paragraphs.en: "I was so upset last night I didn't think about my clothes at all," Anne replied. "I'll fold them neatly tonight. They always made us do that at the asylum, but half the time I forgot because I rushed to get into bed quietly and imagine things."
paragraphs.zh: “昨晚我心情很糟糕，完全没顾得上换衣服的事。”安妮回答说，“今天晚上我会好好叠好。其实我们在疗养院的时候总是被要求这样做，但很多时候我都忘了，因为急于安静地上床睡觉，并且胡思乱想。”

paragraphs.en: "You must remember better if you stay here," Marilla admonished. "Now, say your prayers and get into bed."
paragraphs.zh: “如果你留在这里，可得好好表现才行。”玛丽拉告诫道，“现在去祷告一下，然后上床睡觉吧。”

paragraphs.en: "I never say any prayers," Anne announced.
paragraphs.zh: “我从不说任何祷告词。”安妮宣布道。

paragraphs.en: Marilla's expression turned from horror to relief. "Why, Anne, what do you mean? Were you never taught to pray?
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉的表情从惊恐转为松了一口气。“安妮，你这是什么意思？你难道从未被教过要祈祷吗？”

paragraphs.en: God always wants little girls to pray. Don't you know who God is?"
paragraphs.zh: 上帝总是希望小女孩祈祷，不是吗？你难道不知道上帝是谁吗？

paragraphs.en: "'God is a spirit, infinite, eternal and unchangeable, in His being, wisdom, power, holiness, justice, goodness, and truth,'" Anne responded promptly.
paragraphs.zh: “神是无限、永恒且不变的灵，祂在存在、智慧、力量、圣洁、公义、善良和真理中都是如此。”安妮迅速回答道。

paragraphs.en: Marilla seemed more at ease. "So you do know something then! You're not quite a heathen.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉似乎轻松了一些：“原来你还是知道些什么的！你可不算什么异教徒。”

paragraphs.en: Where did you learn that?"
paragraphs.zh: “你这是从哪里听来的？”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, from the asylum Sunday-school," Anne said. "They made us learn the whole catechism. I liked it pretty well.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，来自收容所星期日学校，”安妮说，“他们让我们学习了整个教义问答。我还挺喜欢的。”

paragraphs.en: There's something splendid about some of the words—'infinite, eternal and unchangeable.' Isn't that grand? It has such a roll to it."
paragraphs.zh: 有些词非常精彩——“无限、永恒和不变”。不是挺宏伟的吗？读起来真是抑扬顿挫。

paragraphs.en: "We're not talking about poetry, Anne—we are talking about saying your prayers," Marilla said firmly. "Don't you know it's terrible wickedness not to pray every night? I'm afraid you are a very bad little girl."
paragraphs.zh: “我们不是在谈论诗歌，安妮——我们在谈论说晚祷。”玛丽拉坚定地说，“你难道不知道不每天晚上祈祷是非常邪恶的行为吗？我恐怕你是个非常糟糕的小女孩。”

paragraphs.en: "You'd find it easier to be bad than good if you had red hair," Anne retorted. "People who don't have red hair don't know what trouble is. Mrs. Thomas told me God made my hair red on purpose, and I've never cared about Him since.
paragraphs.zh: “如果你留着红头发，做坏事反而比做好事更容易一些。”安妮反驳道，“那些没有红头发的人压根不懂什么叫麻烦。汤斯夫人告诉我，上帝故意把我的头发染成了红色，从那以后我就不再在乎他了。”

paragraphs.en: And anyhow, I'd always be too tired at night to bother saying prayers."
paragraphs.zh: 而且反正，我晚上总是太累，懒得念祷告。

paragraphs.en: Marilla decided that Anne's religious training must begin immediately. There was no time to lose.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉决定安妮的宗教教育必须立即开始，不能有任何拖延。

paragraphs.en: Anne agreed to say her prayers, though she was happy to oblige Marilla. She promised to follow instructions but suggested a more personal approach: praying in nature or feeling the prayer spontaneously. Marilla felt embarrassed and decided against teaching Anne the traditional "Now I lay me down to sleep."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮答应说她的祷告，尽管她乐于顺从玛丽拉。她承诺会遵循指示，但建议采取一种更个人化的方法：在自然中祈祷或自发地感受祈祷。玛丽拉感到有些尴尬，决定不教安妮传统的“现在我躺下睡觉”的祷词。

paragraphs.en: Instead, she advised Anne to thank God for blessings and humbly ask for what she desired.
paragraphs.zh: 相反，她建议安妮感谢上帝赐予的恩惠，并谦卑地祈求自己所渴望的事物。

paragraphs.en: "Gracious heavenly Father," Anne began, placing her face on Marilla's lap. "I thank Thee for the White Way of Delight and the Lake of Shining Waters, Bonny, and the Snow Queen. I am truly grateful for them.
paragraphs.zh: “仁慈的天父，”安妮开始说道，把脸贴在玛丽拉的大腿上。“感谢您赐予我光明大道和闪耀之湖贝诺尼以及雪女王。我对它们怀有真正的感激之情。”

paragraphs.en: As for my wishes, I only ask to stay at Green Gables and to be good-looking when I grow up."
paragraphs.zh: 至于我的愿望，我只希望将来能留在绿山墙，并且长大后相貌出众。

paragraphs.en: Anne signed off with a respectful closing, ending her prayer.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮用一句恭敬的问候语结束了她的祷告。

paragraphs.en: Anne got up eagerly, asking, "Did I do all right? I could have made it more flowery if I'd had more time."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮迫不及待地站起来，问道：“我做得怎么样？如果有更多时间的话，我可以把话说得更诗意一些。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla, remembering that Anne's prayer was due to spiritual ignorance rather than irreverence, tucked her into bed. She vowed to teach Anne a proper prayer the next day and left with the light on.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉想起安妮的祈祷只是因为精神上的无知而非不敬，便帮她掖好了被子。她暗自发誓第二天一定要教给安妮正确的祷告方式，然后才关了灯离开。

paragraphs.en: Anne called out, "I just remembered something. Shouldn't I have said 'Amen' instead of 'yours respectfully'? That’s how ministers do it.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮喊道：“我刚想起一件事。我不是应该说‘阿门’而不是‘敬上’吗？牧师们就是这么做的。”

paragraphs.en: I felt a prayer should end in some way."
paragraphs.zh: 我觉得祈祷应该以某种方式结束。

paragraphs.en: Marilla replied, "I don’t think it will make much difference." She wished Anne a good night and watched her cuddle into bed.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回答说：“我觉得这差别不大。”她祝安妮晚安，看着她钻进被窝。

paragraphs.en: In the kitchen, Marilla set the candle firmly on the table and glared at Matthew. "Matthew Cuthbert, we need to adopt that child and teach her something. She’s almost a perfect heathen.
paragraphs.zh: 在厨房里，玛丽拉把蜡烛稳稳地放在桌子上，瞪了马修一眼。“马修·库伯伯，我们得收养那个孩子，并且好好教她。她几乎是个十足的异教徒。”

paragraphs.en: I’ll send her to the manse tomorrow for prayers and borrow the Peep of the Day series. And she'll go to Sunday school as soon as I can get suitable clothes made."
paragraphs.zh: 我明天会把她送到牧师家去祈祷，并借来《晨光系列》书籍。至于周日学校，等我能给她做妥当的衣服后就送她去。

paragraphs.en: Marilla concluded, "I foresee a lot on my hands. But we must face our share of trouble in this world."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉总结道：“我预见自己要操心不少。但在这个世界上，我们必须面对我们的那份麻烦。”
